rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for quotation marks when the single-versus-double form is not specified.

example.english: The editor said this sentence needs an inverted comma at each end.
example.jyutping: pin1 cap1 waa6 ni1 geoi3 jiu3 gaa1 jan5 hou2

rows.note: Use this when the quotation marks are specifically double marks such as “ ”.

example.english: The editor told me to put the book title between double quotation marks; each one is an inverted comma.
example.traditional: 編輯叫我用雙引號括住書名。
example.jyutping: pin1 cap1 giu3 ngo5 jung6 soeng1 jan5 hou2 kut3 zyu6 syu1 meng2

rows.note: Use this when the quotation marks are specifically single marks such as ‘ ’.

example.english: This quotation should use single quotation marks, not double ones; each mark is an inverted comma.
example.traditional: 呢段引文要用單引號，唔好用雙引號。
example.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 jan5 man4 jiu3 jung6 daan1 jan5 hou2 m4 hou2 jung6 soeng1 jan5 hou2
